Amarna Miller’s Syria Visit

Syrian journalist Ammar al-Ma’moun said he had contacted Miller through Instagram. According to him, Miller said she had traveled to Syria without an official invitation, paid for the trip herself, and described claims that the Syrian government had covered her expenses as “fake news.” Al-Ma’moun added that Miller had refused to allow him to publish a screenshot of their conversation because she was concerned about her safety. Miller’s post about her trip is also no longer available on her Instagram account, although the reason for its disappearance remains unclear.

On social media, some users criticized her presence at the Umayyad Mosque, referring to her previous professional career, while others defended her right to visit Syria. The controversy grew after claims about the cost of her trip began circulating online. Posts shared by social media users alleged that Syria’s Ministry of Culture had allocated $23,400 to cover Miller’s first-class airfare, hotel accommodation, and transportation expenses.
